ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the trailing edge margin and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white field across both lobes. Distinct circular black focal spot in the upper-left quadrant. Cluster of four to five small, low-intensity pixel dots arranged vertically near the median notch. Continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by vertical pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels. Peaks are most dense in the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward-sweeping curves originating from the median notch and terminating in acute, upwardly hooked lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, textured brown and tan pixel aggregates (barnacles) concentrated exclusively on the distal lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short, unaligned dark-gray linear streaks visible in the lower-right quadrant near the water-line interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent, dark circular depression (scar or puncture) located on the upper-left lobe surface, approximately 15% distance from the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water spray and shedding droplets along the trailing edge margin, creating localized high-intensity pixel noise against the blue background.
